papers.title: Roleplaying with Structure: Synthetic Therapist-Client Conversation Generation from Questionnaires

training_data.name: SQPsychConv (Gemma)
training_data.quote: AIMH/SQPsychConv_gemma, synthetic therapist-client conversations generated by google/gemma-3-27b-it, conditioned on de-identified structured profiles and questionnaire scores (BDI, HAM-D) from the cohort of Kircher et al. (2019).

training_data.name: SQPsychConv (Gemma) fine-tune split
training_data.quote: The instruction-formatted split used for training is AIMH/SQPsychConv_gemma_finetune.

training_method.objective_quote: This checkpoint is Llama-3-8B-Instruct supervised-fine-tuned on SQPsychConv (Gemma), the synthetic corpus generated by google/gemma-3-27b-it from real, de-identified structured client profiles and psychological questionnaires (BDI, HAM-D).
training_method.update_scope_quote: we perform a full BF16 fine-tuning of Llama3-8B-Instruct on Psych8k, using the same hyperparameters as CAMEL (5 epochs, learning rate 2e-4). We use the same hyperparameters for finetuning SQPsychLLM.

source_claims.quote: we fine-tune Llama3-8B-Instruct on each portion of the synthetic dataset

description.text:
`SQPsychLLM-8b-gemma` is a chat model fine-tuned to **roleplay a therapist** in synthetic, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)-informed counseling conversations. It is part of the **SQPsychLLM** family released with the paper *Roleplaying with Structure: Synthetic Therapist-Client Conversation Generation from Questionnaires*.

This checkpoint is **Llama-3-8B-Instruct** supervised-fine-tuned on **SQPsychConv (Gemma)**, the synthetic corpus generated by `google/gemma-3-27b-it` from real, de-identified structured client profiles and psychological questionnaires (BDI, HAM-D).

output_type.quote: SQPsychLLM-8b-gemma is a chat model fine-tuned to roleplay a therapist in synthetic, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)-informed counseling conversations.

use_claim.quote: SQPsychLLM-8b-gemma is a chat model fine-tuned to roleplay a therapist in synthetic, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)-informed counseling conversations.

warning.quote: This model must not be used to: provide therapy, diagnosis, or any clinical decision to real people;

serving.system_prompt: You are an empathetic therapist conducting a CBT-informed session.
serving.notes: The repository file list has no tokenizer and no adapter. tokenizer_config.json, tokenizer.json, chat_template.jinja, and adapter_config.json return 404. generation_config.json also sets max_length 4096. The card example uses temperature 0.7, do_sample true, and max_new_tokens 512. The system sentence above is that example. A fine-tune row instead stores the instruction "You are a state-licensed therapist trained in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), please answer the patient." The published training script concatenates input and output and does not prepend that instruction.

evaluation_reported.text: The paper evaluates SQPsychLLM gemma on CounselingBench (zero-shot and zero-shot chain-of-thought), CBT Bench, an LLM panel, and a blinded expert preference comparison. It says experts preferred SQPsychLLM gemma over CAMEL, Psych8k, and Llama-3-8B-Instruct.

discrepancies: The inventory dataset is AIMH/SQPsychConv_gemma, which is the id in the card YAML. The card says the instruction-formatted split used for training is AIMH/SQPsychConv_gemma_finetune.
